info.title: MeraDhan Customer API
info.description:
Complete OpenAPI specification for MeraDhan **customer-level** backend APIs.

**Excluded:** CRM-only routes (`/api/crm/*`), CRM bond create/update, CRM web tracking list endpoints.

**Authentication:**
- `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` OR `Cookie: token=<jwt>`
- Public routes: no auth
- Public Bonds API: `x-api-key` header

**Standard response envelope:** `{ statusCode, success, message, responseData? }`
